summary: Delta-based update of a widget-like object. Reads a two-field input pair via DualFieldRead, samples a current value through vtable method +24, then - if the flag byte at this+0xED is set - computes the delta between the DualFieldRead value and the sampled value, compares it against the stored delta at this+0xE0, and when it changed stores it, recomputes the layout via ShortComputation_8970 and notifies through vtable method +44 with argument 1.

operations.description: Call DualFieldRead with two output locals to read an external two-field pair used as the delta source.
Invoke vtable method at offset 0x18 (+24) on this; its return value v2 becomes the current value to compare against the delta source.
Invoke vtable method at offset 0x1C (+28) on this; return value ignored.
Invoke vtable method at offset 0x24 (+36) on this; return value ignored.
Guard on the flag byte at this+0xED (this[237]); when zero the whole delta-update body is skipped and only the flag byte is returned.
Compute the delta as the DualFieldRead first value minus the sampled current value v2.
Guard on whether the stored delta at this+0xE0 (this+56 dwords) differs from the freshly computed delta.
Store the computed delta into this+0xE0.
Call ShortComputation_8970(this) to recompute the scroll/content layout after the delta changed.
Invoke vtable method at offset 0x2C (+44) on this with argument 1 to notify listeners of the change.
Return the last byte/status value in v3 (the flag value when the body is skipped, otherwise the vtable +44 result).
